definitions.gloss: center, hub, nerve center, central authority
definitions.explanation: The central controlling part of an organization, system, or body. The place where key decisions are made or key functions are controlled.

examples.japanese: {政治|せいじ}の{中枢|ちゅうすう}を{担|にな}う。
examples.english: To play a central role in politics.

examples.japanese: {中枢|ちゅうすう}{神経|しんけい}が{体|からだ}を{制御|せいぎょ}する。
examples.english: The central nervous system controls the body.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{長年|ながねん}{政権|せいけん}の{中枢|ちゅうすう}にいて、{多|おお}くの{政策|せいさく}に{関|かか}わってきた。
examples.english: She has been at the center of government for many years and has been involved in many policies.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{中|ちゅう} (center) + {枢|すう} (pivot, hub)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {中枢|ちゅうすう}: nerve center, central command (emphasis on control/decision-making)
- {中核|ちゅうかく}: core, nucleus (emphasis on essential element)
- {中心|ちゅうしん}: center (general, most common)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中枢|ちゅうすう}{神経|しんけい}: central nervous system
- {権力|けんりょく}の{中枢|ちゅうすう}: center of power
- {政治|せいじ}の{中枢|ちゅうすう}: political nerve center
- {中枢|ちゅうすう}を{担|にな}う: to serve at the center
